title: "Issues"
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

get_volume <- function(year_num) {
  if (year_num < 2009) {
    year_num - 2000  # R News: 2001 = vol 1
  } else {
    year_num - 2008  # R Journal: 2009 = vol 1
  }
}

# Get all issue directories
issue_dirs <- list.dirs("issues", recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)

# Sort by year and issue number (descending - newest first)
issue_order <- order(
  -as.numeric(sub("-.*", "", issue_dirs)),
  -as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", issue_dirs))
)
issue_dirs <- issue_dirs[issue_order]

# Group by year
years <- unique(sub("-.*", "", issue_dirs))

for (year in years) {
  year_num <- as.numeric(year)
  vol <- get_volume(year_num)
  cat(sprintf("\n## %s (Volume %s)\n\n", year, vol))

  year_issues <- issue_dirs[grepl(paste0("^", year, "-"), issue_dirs)]
  for (issue in year_issues) {
    iss <- as.numeric(sub(".*-", "", issue))
    url <- sprintf("issues/%s/", issue)
    cat(sprintf("[Issue %s](%s)\n\n", iss, url))
  }
}
```
